summary: First E2E iteration on 21Reservation. Backend: 28/28 pytest cases pass (auth, restaurant/public, areas/tables/opening-hours CRUD, bookings with closest-fit auto-assign + overlap rejection + state machine, public availability day/month + closed Monday, public booking, reports, customers). Frontend: login works with pre-filled owner creds, list stats cards + quick actions render, calendar/timeline navigate, tables page CRUD works (create area, add table, delete), opening-hours weekly Monday 12:30-15:00 saved and visible, customers search 'Luca' filters correctly, reports page renders recharts + KPIs, IT/EN language toggle works, NewBookingModal opens with auto-suggested tables highlighted (T2/T4/D1/D2 which are all small-capacity for 2 persons), and the full 4-step /book/demo public wizard completes ending with the 'Grazie!' thank-you screen and a real booking created.

minor.issue: open_time/close_time are declared required in OpeningHourCreate even when specific_date + is_closed=true is used to mark a day as closed. Callers must send dummy '00:00' values, which is confusing.
Response uses keys total_no_show / total_cancelled while the review request wording mentioned no_show / cancelled — cosmetic mismatch with spec, but data is present.

ui_bugs.issue: Review spec expects data-testid=kpi-bookings/kpi-guests/kpi-noshow/kpi-cancelled/kpi-occupancy but none of these test-ids exist. Only report-from, report-to, report-chart are present. Adds friction for automated testing.

Review spec expects data-testid=btn-new-area / btn-new-table, but the actual test-ids are btn-add-area, btn-add-table-<areaName>, new-area-name, new-table-name. Naming mismatch with spec (functionality works).

Review spec expects [data-testid=quick-N] but implementation uses persons-quick-N. Also step 4 uses contact-name/contact-email/contact-phone/contact-terms instead of the spec's step4-name/email/phone/terms.

issues: Timeline default viewport shows 11:00-17:00 columns; the primary dinner service window 19:00-23:00 is only accessible via horizontal scroll. Consider auto-scrolling to the first active opening window on load.

action_items: (Optional) Align Reports KPI test-ids with spec (kpi-bookings, kpi-guests, kpi-noshow, kpi-cancelled, kpi-occupancy).
(Optional) Align Tables page test-ids with spec (btn-new-area, btn-new-table).
(Optional) Align Public wizard step 1/4 test-ids with spec (quick-N, step4-name/email/phone/terms).
Consider relaxing OpeningHourCreate validation so open_time/close_time are optional when is_closed=true or specific_date is a closed exception.
Consider aligning /api/reports/summary field names with spec (no_show/cancelled), or update spec.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is ~743 LOC — approaching the 700-line threshold, consider splitting into routers (auth, bookings, tables, public, reports).
OpeningHourCreate.open_time/close_time being required conflicts with the closed-exception use case; consider Optional[str].
public_create_booking silently proceeds if body.customer_email is empty for the Emergent email step — currently guarded by try/except which is correct (best-effort).
Timeline default view does not scroll to the dinner window; UX polish opportunity.

success_rate.frontend: ~90% (all core flows pass; several data-testid names differ from spec but underlying UI works)

test_credentials: owner@demo.com / demo1234 (owner); staff@demo.com / demo1234 (staff); public subdomain: demo
seed_data_creation: Auto-seeded on backend startup (idempotent via subdomain='demo'). Tests use TEST_ prefix and clean up.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend suite lives at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py with conftest.py that loads REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL from /app/frontend/.env. pytest.ini in /app/backend enforces -n 2 --dist loadscope; run serial with '-n 0'. All 28 tests pass. For UI, correct routes are /hours (not /opening-hours) and /bookings/{list,calendar,timeline}; public wizard testids differ from spec — see frontend_issues section for the actual names.
rca_of_the_issue: N/A — no blocking bugs found. Discrepancies between review-request testid names and actual implementation are documented above.
